verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs include 'Test Data' and 'Moving to Production' sections and an explicit Apple Pay sandbox testing page. That points to a separate test environment kept apart from production, but the pack contains only page titles, so isolation scope and coverage across payment methods are unproven. Missing for 10: documented general sandbox environment details (separate credentials/endpoints, isolation from production data), sandbox coverage beyond Apple Pay, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
